stem:
Students fill a cart with books. The cart has a handle on each end.

Which actions will make moving the cart in one direction easiest for the students?

options.label: F
options.text: Student 1 pulls the cart to the left while Student 2 pulls the cart to the right.

options.label: G
options.text: Student 1 pulls the cart to the left while Student 2 pushes the cart to the left.

options.label: H
options.text: Student 1 pushes the cart to the right while Student 2 pushes the cart downward.

options.label: J
options.text: Student 1 pushes the cart to the right while Student 2 pulls the cart upward.

visual_elements: image of two students pulling a cart with books labeled Student 1 and Student 2, with Left and Right directional arrows
